title: Vanilla Emerge
description: Vanilla Emerge takes the base Minecraft experience and gently upgrades it cleaner, smoother, and more enjoyable, without ever feeling overdone.

Check the Gallery to see some of the resource pack features! ## Explanation of Mods ⬇️
Spoiler ### Visual Mods ⬇️ 3D Skin Layers: Adds depth to player skins by rendering outer layers in 3D. Armor Stand Arms: Allows armor stands to have visible and usable arms. Better Smoke: Improves the look of smoke particles for a more realistic feel. Boat Item View: Better View at the item you are holding. Bookshelf Inspector: Shows hidden data inside chiseled bookshelves. Continuity: Enables connected textures for a smoother visual experience. Explosive Enhancement: Enhances explosion visuals with better particles and effects. Fancy World Animations: Adds immersive animations to various world elements. Glowing Torchflower: Makes torchflowers emit a soft glow. Immersive Hotbar: Adds animations and visual polish to the hotbar. Jade: Displays useful block and entity information in a clean UI. Not Enough Animations: Adds missing third-person animations for better immersion. Particle Rain: Improves rain with better particle effects. Pick Up Notifier: Shows item pickup notifications on screen. Punchy: Adds a lot of amazing first person animations. Scholar: Improving book experience in Minecraft two pages at a time Serene Seasons: Adds seasonal changes affecting visuals and environment. Shoulder Surfing Reloaded: Adds an over-the-shoulder third-person camera. Sodium Shadowy Path Blocks: Improves shadows and visuals of path blocks. (Not Visual) Sound Physics Remastered: Adds realistic sound behavior based on environment. Spawn Animations: Adds animations when mobs spawn into the world. Status Effect Bars: Displays active effects as clean bars on screen. Subtle Effects: Adds big visual improvements for immersion. Voxy: Distant Horizons but better. Wakes: Wave effects in water. Visual Workbench: Keeps items visually inside crafting tables. Do a Barrel Roll: Adds dynamic camera roll effects while flying. Fast Item Frames: Better Item Frames TBH Wet Sand: New Sand Blocks. ### Useful Mods ⬇️ Anti Enderman Grief: Prevents Endermen from picking up and moving blocks. AppleSkin: Shows detailed hunger and saturation info. BetterF3: Improves the debug (F3) screen with cleaner info. Better Statistics Screen: Upgrades the stats menu with better UI. Cherished Worlds: Prevents accidental deletion of important worlds. Client Sort: Adds sorting options for inventories. Crops Love Rain: Crops grow faster during rain. Cubes Without Borders: Borderless fullscreen support without lag. Cut Through: Allows interaction through small hitboxes (like grass). Delete World To Trash: Moves deleted worlds to trash instead of permanent deletion. Diagonal Fences/Walls/Windows: Allows diagonal placement for better building. Easy Magic: Simplifies and improves the enchanting system. Essential Mod: Adds multiplayer features like friends and invites. Fuel Info: Displays fuel burn times in tooltips. Gamma Utils: Adjusts brightness beyond normal limits + Fullbright. Horseman: Improves horse-related mechanics and UI. Just Enough Items (JEI): Shows crafting recipes and item usages. Litematica ❤️❤️❤️: Powerful schematic and building helper mod. Mouse Tweaks: Improves inventory mouse controls. Naturally Trimmed: Mobs might born with trimmed armor. Ping Wheel: Adds a communication wheel for multiplayer. Right Click Harvest: Harvest and replant crops with right-click. Shulker Box Tooltip: Preview contents of shulker boxes. Xaero's Minimap/World Map: Adds minimap and full world map. Zoomify: Adds smooth zoom functionality.
